true_pairing_note: true multiome: the RNA partner of ATAC cell i IS cell i, so every arm is a permutation (or, for the metacell arms, a resampling) of the identity and the self-hit rate needs no join to compute

rand_celltype_donor_1to1.stratum_definition: cell_type x donor (person; may cross site)

pseudomultiome_k5.row_unit: one row per (metacell, slot); the metacell is the unit and the ATAC/RNA sides are drawn independently -- the slot pairing is bookkeeping only

pseudomultiome_k10.row_unit: one row per (metacell, slot); the metacell is the unit and the ATAC/RNA sides are drawn independently -- the slot pairing is bookkeeping only

headline.interpretation: the donor-blind arm is the pairing a cell-type-only method builds; the donor-aware arm is the same construction with the batch constraint added. PBMC 10k (one donor) cannot separate these two.
